propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts must begin with an identical byte-for-byte shared prefix containing the full plan text to enable provider-side cache prefix reuse.
The shared reviewing-stance preamble must be single-sourced as a code constant (prompts.SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE) to enforce byte-identity across all renderers and prevent drift.

The exhaustiveness directive ('When surfacing findings, enumerate EVERY independent defect you find in THIS run; do not defer deeper or additional findings to a later review round.') must be a bullet in the shared preamble and reach every Pass-1 entry point (finder, container, ISF).
Per-run finding listings must remain routed to the user message (base_instructions → instructions) and must not appear in any stable cached system segment.
The Pass-1 warm gate must measure the actual cached prefix bytes (SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + plan) not the plan alone, ensuring the gate condition threshold is accurate relative to bytes actually sent.
